mistakes.why: That is <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>3</mn></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int_0^3 (f - g)\,dx</annotation></semantics></math>, where the middle piece counts as <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>4</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">-\frac{1}{4}</annotation></semantics></math>. items.q: The graphs cross at <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>a</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = a</annotation></semantics></math>, <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>b</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = b</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = c</annotation></semantics></math>, with <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo><</mo><mi>b</mi><mo><</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">a < b < c</annotation></semantics></math>. mistakes.why: That is <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">a</annotation></semantics></math>, the left crossing. <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">b</annotation></semantics></math> is the right one.

items.q: The shaded region is the base of a solid whose cross sections perpendicular to the <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x</annotation></semantics></math>-axis are squares. Which expression gives its volume?
options: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mi>a</mi><mi>b</mi></msubsup><msup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>e</mi><mi>x</mi></msup></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int_a^b \left(4 - x^2 - e^x\right)^2\,dx</annotation></semantics></math>

<math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mi>a</mi><mi>b</mi></msubsup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">[</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi></mrow></msup></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">]</mo></mrow><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int_a^b \left[(4 - x^2)^2 - e^{2x}\right]\,dx</annotation></semantics></math>

<math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mi>a</mi><mi>b</mi></msubsup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>e</mi><mi>x</mi></msup></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\left(\int_a^b \left(4 - x^2 - e^x\right)\,dx\right)^2</annotation></semantics></math>

<math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mi>a</mi><mi>b</mi></msubsup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>e</mi><mi>x</mi></msup></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int_a^b \left(4 - x^2 - e^x\right)\,dx</annotation></semantics></math>

items.q: Find the volume of the solid with this base and square cross sections perpendicular to the <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x</annotation></semantics></math>-axis.

mistakes.why: That squares each curve: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi></mrow></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(4 - x^2)^2 - e^{2x}</annotation></semantics></math>. The side is the difference; square the whole difference.

That is the area of the base. The square slices have area <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>s</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s^2</annotation></semantics></math>.

items.q: A different solid on this base has cross sections perpendicular to the <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x</annotation></semantics></math>-axis that are rectangles of height 2 (the other side lies in the base). Find its volume.

mistakes.why: That uses <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>s</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A = 2s^2</annotation></semantics></math>. A rectangle with sides <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>s</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s</annotation></semantics></math> and 2 has area <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>s</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2s</annotation></semantics></math>.

That is the volume with squares. Here the height is always 2, so <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>s</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A(x) = 2s</annotation></semantics></math>.

items.q: The base of a solid is the region bounded by <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = y^2</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = 1</annotation></semantics></math>. Cross sections perpendicular to the <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y</annotation></semantics></math>-axis are squares. Find the volume.

mistakes.why: That is the area of the base. Square each slice's side, <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1 - y^2</annotation></semantics></math>.

That is half the volume, from <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = 0</annotation></semantics></math> to <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1</annotation></semantics></math>. The base runs from <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = -1</annotation></semantics></math> to <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = 1</annotation></semantics></math>.

items.q: The base of a solid is the disk <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>≤</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x^2 + y^2 \le 4</annotation></semantics></math>. Cross sections perpendicular to the <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x</annotation></semantics></math>-axis are squares. Find the volume.

mistakes.why: You used <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msqrt><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></msqrt></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sqrt{4 - x^2}</annotation></semantics></math> as the side. That only reaches from the <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x</annotation></semantics></math>-axis to the top of the circle; the side spans the whole disk, <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn><msqrt><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></msqrt></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2\sqrt{4 - x^2}</annotation></semantics></math>.

That is the area of the disk. Each slice's area is <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>s</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s^2 = 4(4 - x^2)</annotation></semantics></math>; integrate it.

items.q: The base of a solid is the region under <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mi>x</mi></msqrt></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = \sqrt{x}</annotation></semantics></math> for <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>≤</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>≤</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0 \le x \le 4</annotation></semantics></math>. Cross sections perpendicular to the <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x</annotation></semantics></math>-axis are rectangles of height 3. Find the volume.

mistakes.why: That is the volume with squares, <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>4</mn></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msqrt><mi>x</mi></msqrt><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int_0^4 (\sqrt{x})^2\,dx</annotation></semantics></math>. These rectangles have area <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>3</mn><msqrt><mi>x</mi></msqrt></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">3\sqrt{x}</annotation></semantics></math>.
That is the area of the base. Multiply each slice's base by its height 3.

items.q: A concrete footing has as its base the region between <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = 0</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>−</mo><mfrac><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mn>3</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = 3 - \frac{x^2}{3}</annotation></semantics></math> for <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>≤</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>≤</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">-3 \le x \le 3</annotation></semantics></math>, with <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y</annotation></semantics></math> in feet. Cross sections perpendicular to the <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x</annotation></semantics></math>-axis are squares. Find the volume of the footing.

mistakes.why: That is the area of the base, in square feet. Each square slice has area <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>−</mo><mfrac><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mn>3</mn></mfrac></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\left(3 - \frac{x^2}{3}\right)^2</annotation></semantics></math>.

items.q: The volume of a solid with square cross sections has no <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>π</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\pi</annotation></semantics></math>, even when its base has a curved edge. Why?
options: Each slice is a square with area <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>s</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s^2</annotation></semantics></math>, and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>s</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s^2</annotation></semantics></math> has no <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>π</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\pi</annotation></semantics></math> in it
<math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>π</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\pi</annotation></semantics></math> cancels out when the integral is evaluated

<math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>π</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\pi</annotation></semantics></math> is left out because the base lies flat in the <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">xy</annotation></semantics></math>-plane
<math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>π</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\pi</annotation></semantics></math> is needed when the base region has a curved edge
